## README.md
# public-bioclimate

Bioclimatic variables aggregated to H3 hexagonal cells, for climate-exposure and
species-distribution work.

## CHELSA 2.1 future bioclimate — SSP3-7.0, 2041–2070

Downscaled CMIP6 bioclimatic variables from [CHELSA v2.1](https://chelsa-climate.org/),
aggregated to **H3 resolution 8** (cells of about 0.74 km²) over the **global land surface**.

- **195,048,994 cells** across 108 hive partitions
- **Five climate models kept as separate columns**, plus their median, minimum and maximum
- **Seven bioclimatic variables**, temperature in °C and precipitation in mm
- License: **CC0-1.0**

### Variables

Seven bioclimatic variables, each with five climate model columns plus `median`, `min` and `max`
(60 columns in all):

| variable | meaning | units | observed range |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bio1` | annual mean temperature | °C | −51.95 – 38.05 |
| `bio4` | temperature seasonality (SD of monthly mean × 100) | °C × 100 | 4.6 – 2318 |
| `bio5` | max temperature of warmest month | °C | −31.85 – 52.05 |
| `bio6` | min temperature of coldest month | °C | −65.45 – 29.55 |
| `bio12` | annual precipitation | mm | 0.4 – 6553.5 |
| `bio15` | precipitation seasonality (CV) | % | 3.36 – 265.68 |
| `bio17` | precipitation of driest quarter | mm | 0 – 4966.7 |

Column names follow `<variable>_<model>`, e.g. `bio1_gfdl_esm4`, plus `bio1_median`,
`bio1_min`, `bio1_max`. The five models are GFDL-ESM4, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MPI-ESM1-2-HR,
MRI-ESM2-0 and UKESM1-0-LL.

H3 index columns: `h8` (native, the usual join key), `h5` and `h4` for coarser joins, and `h0`
as the partition key.

All five models are kept so any summary can be computed directly, and so the disagreement
between models stays visible. For annual mean temperature the models differ by **2.0 °C on
average**, and by as much as **10.4 °C** where they agree least.

### ⚠️ Annual precipitation is clipped at 6553.5 mm

The source stores precipitation as a 16-bit integer at 0.1 mm resolution, so `bio12` cannot
exceed **6553.5 mm** — below the ~11,900 mm reached in the wettest places on Earth. Cells at
that value are a **lower bound**, not a measurement: **247,217 cells** hit it in the median and
**348,969** in at least one model. Exclude them from any analysis of precipitation extremes:

```sql
SELECT ... WHERE bio12_median < 6553.5
```

### Query with DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;

-- projected annual mean temperature near Berkeley, California
SELECT bio1_median, bio1_min, bio1_max
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-bioclimate/chelsa-2-1/ssp370-2041-2070/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
WHERE h8 = h3_latlng_to_cell(37.87, -122.27, 8);
```

Restrict to a single partition when you know the region — it reads far less data:

```sql
SELECT AVG(bio1_median)
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-bioclimate/chelsa-2-1/ssp370-2041-2070/hex/h0=578923658349641727/data_0.parquet');
```

### Joining against other datasets

Join on `h8`, which is the resolution this dataset is stored at and the one most of the
catalog shares:

```sql
SELECT p.Unit_Nm, AVG(c.bio1_median) AS mean_temp_c
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-padus/padus-4-1/fee/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') p
JOIN read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-bioclimate/chelsa-2-1/ssp370-2041-2070/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') c
  USING (h8)
GROUP BY p.Unit_Nm;
```

Datasets held at coarser resolutions can be joined on `h5` or `h4` instead.

### Visualising in MapLibre GL JS

This dataset ships as H3 hex parquet only — there is no PMTiles layer and therefore no
`source-layer` to set. To draw it, query the cells you need and convert them to polygons
with `h3_cell_to_boundary_wkt()`, then add the result as a GeoJSON source:

```js
map.addSource('bioclim', { type: 'geojson', data: featureCollectionFromQuery });
map.addLayer({
  id: 'bioclim-fill',
  type: 'fill',
  source: 'bioclim',
  paint: {
    'fill-color': [
      'interpolate', ['linear'], ['get', 'bio1_median'],
      -20, '#2c7bb6',  0, '#abd9e9',  10, '#ffffbf',  20, '#fdae61',  35, '#d7191c'
    ],
    'fill-opacity': 0.8
  }
});
```

### Important to know

- These are **projections, not observations**. Every value is conditional on the SSP3-7.0
  scenario and on the model that produced it.
- Values are **already means** over the source pixels in each cell. Combining cells means
  averaging again, weighted by cell area — not adding. H3 cell area varies with latitude.
- **Footprint is global land.** The CHELSA source also covers the ocean; this dataset is
  restricted to cells intersecting the WWF Terrestrial Ecoregions of the World, which
  includes Antarctica.

### Scenarios and periods

This collection is SSP3-7.0 for 2041–2070. Further scenario and period combinations
(SSP1-2.6, SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5 across 2011–2040, 2041–2070 and 2071–2100) are being added as
sibling collections in this bucket.
